title: 1871 shop signs name real firms from the 1871 directory
items: Round the 1871 stops, the shops on Lake, Clark, Randolph, Washington, Madison, State, Dearborn and LaSalle carry over 700 firms from Edwards' 1871 directory, set by their old street numbers.
Signs come in period forms: fascia boards, lettered friezes and string courses, boards between upper windows, hanging signs on iron brackets, pier boards, gilt window lettering and awning valances.
Click a shop to see its firm, its trade, the directory listing with its page, and how sure the placement is.
Shops the directory does not reach carry a trade from the classified pages for that street, never the same as their neighbours'.
At Light detail the hanging, pier and valance signs are left off; the firm names stay.
